name: video2player
description: Firefox extension (Android and desktop): detects videos on web pages and opens them in a built-in touch-first player.
author: kiraitachi

scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist -a artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run -s dist
scripts.start:android: npm run build && web-ext run -s dist -t firefox-android --firefox-apk org.mozilla.firefox --firefox-apk-component .AppSolidDark
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ext && npm run lint:privacy
scripts.lint:ext: npm run build && web-ext lint -s dist
